page-reporting-netmap.name: Reporting: Network Map
page-reporting-netmap.description: View the network map, the traffic of each device and the packets the firewall blocked for it. Grants read access to the data the map is built from.

page-reporting-netmap-edit.name: Reporting: Network Map: edit devices
page-reporting-netmap-edit.description: Give devices a name, a kind and notes in the network map. Changing DHCP reservations needs the Kea DHCP privileges as well.

page-reporting-netmap-scan.name: Reporting: Network Map: scan devices
page-reporting-netmap-scan.description: Start nmap port scans of devices on the networks attached to the firewall.
